title: THE PAUSE BOX FRAME IS WIDE ENOUGH
why: Seen on the 4K Undercroft pause screenshot of 2026-10-08: on the floor the pause box shows three buttons (RETURN TO THE UNDERCROFT, SETTINGS, RETURN TO CHARACTER SELECTION) and the row all but touched the sides of the fixed 780 pixel frame. The frame now fits the widest line in the box as well as its height (v19.90), never narrower than before.
now: The pause box frame leaves room around its buttons in the Undercroft.

edits.anchor: var b=document.getElementById('pausebox'), i, c, t=1e9, bo=-1e9;
edits.replacement: var b=document.getElementById('pausebox'), i, c, t=1e9, bo=-1e9, wd=0;

b.style.setProperty('--pbh',Math.max(400,Math.ceil(bo-t)+64)+'px');
  b.style.setProperty('--pbw',Math.max(780,Math.ceil(wd)+96)+'px');   // v16.xx, seen on the 4K floor pause screenshot (2026-10-08): the floor's three buttons all but touched the frame sides
